productRoutingFindings.finding: The actual H&E reader inherits an IHC technology schematic labeled Stained protein (HER2, PD-L1), while the H&E definition says the broad stain is not a named-protein measurement.
productRoutingFindings.observedExcerpt: Showing the technology this term belongs to: Histopathology & immunohistochemistry.
productRoutingFindings.proposedAction: Map H&E to a morphology/section schematic with a broad-stain legend, or suppress the antigen-specific inherited drawing for this term. Keep IHC and H&E measurement identity distinct.
productRoutingFindings.dependency: Product rendering/mapping requires owner approval under docs/PRODUCT-APPROVAL.md. No approval flag, code edit or deployment is made here.
